title: Musicians and sports: tennis, baseball teams and hobbies
summary: Talk of other musicians who played baseball and tennis, and Albert's view that outside activity balances music.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Did the other bands have teams?

Yes, there were a few teams. You know, in those days, most of the guys got out and did some kind of athletic activities when they weren't too tired naturally. And it was a common thing to see some of the musicians out playing baseball or some of them played tennis.
Yeah, well you thought of that because I got them in tennis. I didn't know John.
No, no, no, I didn't even notice a bit.
Who played tennis? I never heard of that.
Well, this fellow, Merle Turner, the singer, he played, the guy did everything. He played tennis. He swam like a fish. He was an outdoor lover. I think of musicians as being fishermen.
Some of them played baseball. I know Harry James had a team and like his band.
Well, like I said, in those days, most all the bands had some sort of outdoor activity that they would like to do. Basie's men, what about Basie?
They didn't try to remember being in baseball.
Well, now, after Basie and I separated, in the early years, I got them in contact with Basie too much. So I don't know what happened.

Well, you know, I always thought that sports and music went together. And boxers would sometimes turn out to be musicians. What about Archie Moore that he threw around with the trots of them? I keep hearing these different things because it may be just publicity, but… And some of the dances.
I never knew too much. Well, you say dances, that goes to Chiharay.
Yeah.
And I imagine it's like anything else. A fellow tries to do more than one thing. He gets bored doing one thing, so he picks up some other thing to do, some other hobby.
Well, it takes mind, body, and feelings to do both things. Sports and…
That's right. One helps the other.
Yeah.

That's how I felt about it. Mine was for more reasons than one. Mine was for friendship safe to keep my body in shape, and thinking faculties, all that goes along with when you get away from just one set thing, like music, it'll run you crazy.

Yeah, well you had so much responsibility, you needed to do something to relax. Yeah, to deviate from work. Yeah, well I need to do that too. I need to do that too. Yeah, it's wonderful to have, to meet those friends and you know, like that. And you know people in a different world, it seems to me through school. Right. You can insult each other, get around, get a lot of these systems or like, but that's my philosophy, not your philosophy.
No, I imagine that strikes me as being correct. And I'm in the same, I'm thinking the same way that you think.
